ConstrixServices1.label: Our Services
ConstrixServices1.text:
From residential buildings to large-scale infrastructure, we deliver end-to-end
construction solutions with quality, innovation and reliability.

items.title: Residential Construction
items.text:
Custom homes, villas, apartments
and housing projects built with
quality and precision.

detail.text:
Our residential construction services are designed to turn your vision into
beautiful and functional homes. From initial planning and design to final
construction, we handle every detail with precision, quality materials and
skilled craftsmanship. Whether it's a modern villa, a family home or a custom
residence, we create spaces that are comfortable, durable and built for the future.

items.title: Commercial Construction
items.text:
Offices, shopping complexes,
showrooms and commercial
spaces for modern businesses.

detail.text: Our commercial construction services deliver offices, retail spaces, showrooms and business complexes that are built to perform. From planning and approvals to construction and handover, we manage every stage with precision, quality materials and strict timelines so your business can move in with confidence.

items.title: Industrial Construction
items.text:
Factories, warehouses and
industrial facilities designed
for efficiency and growth.

detail.text: Our industrial construction services cover factories, warehouses and production facilities engineered for efficiency, safety and long-term growth. We combine strong structural engineering with practical layouts and durable materials to deliver facilities that keep your operations running smoothly.

items.title: Infrastructure Development
items.text:
Roads, bridges, flyovers and
civil infrastructure for stronger
communities.

detail.text: Our infrastructure development services include roads, bridges, flyovers and civil works that connect people and power growth. With experienced engineers, modern equipment and strict quality control, we deliver infrastructure that is safe, durable and built to serve communities for decades.

items.title: Renovation & Remodeling
items.text:
Transforming existing spaces
with innovative renovation
and remodeling solutions.

detail.text: Our renovation and remodeling services breathe new life into existing homes and commercial spaces. From structural upgrades to complete interior makeovers, we plan carefully, work cleanly and deliver results that improve comfort, functionality and value.

items.title: Architecture & Design
items.text:
Creative architectural design,
planning and 3D visualization
for innovative spaces.

detail.text: Our architecture and design team turns ideas into practical, beautiful plans. With creative concepts, detailed drawings and 3D visualization, we help you see your project before it is built and make confident decisions at every step.

items.title: Interior Fit-Out
items.text:
Complete interior fit-out
solutions for residential
and commercial spaces.

detail.text: Our interior fit-out services deliver complete, ready-to-use spaces for homes and businesses. From partitions, ceilings and flooring to lighting, joinery and finishes, we manage every trade to create interiors that look great and work even better.

items.title: Civil Engineering Works
items.text:
Structural and general civil
construction with high engineering
standards.

detail.text: Our civil engineering works cover foundations, structural frames and general civil construction delivered to high engineering standards. We focus on sound design, quality materials and careful execution so every structure stands strong for years to come.

items.title: Project Management
items.text:
End-to-end project management
that keeps your build on time
and within budget.

detail.text: Our project management services keep every part of your build moving in the right direction. We coordinate planning, budgets, contractors, quality checks and timelines so your project is delivered smoothly, transparently and without surprises.

items.title: Building Maintenance

inspections that keep your
property safe and in top shape.

detail.text: Our building maintenance services keep homes, offices and facilities safe, efficient and looking their best. From routine inspections and preventive upkeep to repairs and upgrades, we take care of your property so small issues never turn into costly problems.

detail.intro:
Building a home is one of the most important investments of your life. A well-planned residential
construction project not only gives you a beautiful living space but also ensures long-term durability,
comfort, and value. From initial planning to final handover, every step plays a crucial role in achieving
a successful outcome.

steps.title: Define Your Requirements
steps.text:
Start by identifying your needs, lifestyle and budget. Consider the size of the home, number
of rooms, design preferences and future requirements. A clear vision helps in better
planning and avoids changes during construction.

steps.title: Choose the Right Location
steps.text:
The location of your home affects convenience, connectivity and long-term value. Evaluate
factors like accessibility, nearby amenities, environment and future development in the area
before finalising the site.

steps.title: Work with Experienced Professionals
steps.text:
Partnering with a trusted construction company ensures expert guidance, quality materials
and efficient project management. Experienced professionals help you avoid common
pitfalls and ensure your project is completed on time and within budget.

steps.title: Focus on Quality and Sustainability
steps.text:
Use high-quality materials and modern construction practices to ensure durability and
safety. Incorporating energy-efficient solutions not only reduces long-term costs but also
creates a more comfortable and eco-friendly home.

detail.conclusion:
A successful residential construction project is the result of careful planning, the right team, quality
materials and a focus on long-term value. With the right approach, you can create a home that perfectly
matches your lifestyle and stands the test of time.

ConstrixFAQ1.title: Frequently Asked Questions
ConstrixFAQ1.intro: Find quick answers to common questions about our construction process, cost estimates, timelines, municipal approvals, and post-handover warranties.

items.question: What types of construction projects does Constrix handle?
items.answer: Constrix handles residential homes and villas, commercial towers and office complexes, industrial factories and warehouses, as well as civil infrastructure projects such as roads and bridges. We also offer full renovation and architectural planning services.

items.question: How do I get a cost estimate for my project?
items.answer: You can reach out through our 'Request a Quote' page or contact our team directly. Once we understand your requirements, built-up area, and location, we provide a detailed, itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) with transparent pricing.

items.question: Do you assist with municipal building permits and approvals?
items.answer: Yes, our team assists with preparing architectural drawings, submitting municipal sanctions, and coordinating approvals to ensure full compliance with the National Building Code (NBC) and local bylaws.

items.question: What is the typical timeline for constructing a residential home?
items.answer: A standard residential project typically takes 8 to 14 months depending on total area, design complexity, and finish selections. We provide a milestone-based project schedule prior to starting construction.

items.question: What payment structure do you follow?
items.answer: We follow a milestone-based payment schedule tied to actual progress on-site (such as foundation completion, slab casting per level, masonry, MEP works, and final finishes). You only pay as each stage is completed and verified.

items.question: What warranty do you offer after project completion?
items.answer: We provide a 10-year structural warranty on core concrete and RCC frameworks, along with a 12-month Defect Liability Period covering plumbing, electrical works, and waterproofing after handover.

items.question: Can I make design changes after construction has started?
items.answer: Yes, changes can be accommodated through a formal Variation Order. Our engineering team reviews the requested changes for structural feasibility and provides an updated estimate and timeline for your approval.

items.question: How do you ensure material quality on-site?
items.answer: We procure materials only from certified manufacturers (such as Tata Steel and UltraTech Cement) and conduct regular laboratory cube tests on concrete and steel to ensure high structural strength.

ConstrixTerms1.title: Terms & Conditions
ConstrixTerms1.intro: These terms apply when you access the Constrix website or engage our construction services. By using this site or approving an estimate, you agree to comply with these terms lawfully and in a manner that respects our contractual and safety standards.

items.title: Website information
items.content: We aim to keep website information useful, accurate and current, but project descriptions, service estimates and other content are provided for general information and may change without prior notice. They do not constitute a formal binding construction contract, financial guarantee, or legal advice until a formal agreement is executed.

items.title: Scope of construction services
items.content: Constrix provides residential, commercial, industrial and civil infrastructure construction solutions. Specific project deliverables, material specifications, architectural designs and timelines will be defined in a separate written contract and Bill of Quantities (BOQ) signed between Constrix and the client.

items.title: Estimates and milestone payments
items.content: All cost estimates and quotations remain valid for 30 calendar days from the date of issue. Payments are linked to verified physical construction milestones (such as foundation, slab casting, masonry, MEP installations, and final handover) as outlined in the signed agreement. Invoices must be cleared within the agreed payment window to prevent site mobilization delays.

items.title: Client responsibilities and site access
items.content: The client is responsible for providing unhindered physical access to the project site, confirming legal ownership of the property, securing necessary initial water and electricity connections, and granting prompt written approvals for architectural selections and material finishes.

items.title: Regulatory compliance and building permits
items.content: All works executed by Constrix comply with the National Building Code (NBC) and local municipal bylaws. Where liaison services are engaged, Constrix assists with filing and documentation; however, official municipal scrutiny fees, taxes and statutory charges remain the client's responsibility.

items.title: Project timelines and delays
items.content: Estimated delivery schedules are based on normal working conditions. Extensions of time may be granted in instances of Force Majeure (such as extreme natural disasters, government lockdowns, or unseasonal heavy rains) or client-requested architectural variations outside the original scope.

items.title: Quality standards and warranty
items.content: Constrix provides a 10-year structural warranty on core RCC and concrete frameworks, along with a 12-month Defect Liability Period covering plumbing, electrical works, waterproofing, and surface finishes from the formal handover date. Unauthorized structural modifications by third parties will void the warranty.

items.title: Intellectual property
items.content: Architectural drawings, structural engineering plans, 3D renderings and technical designs created by Constrix remain our intellectual property until all contractual dues are settled. Upon full payment, the client receives a license to use these plans exclusively for the constructed property.

items.title: Limitation of liability
items.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Constrix shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from third-party actions, unauthorized alterations, or delays outside our direct contractual control.

items.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
items.content: These terms and any disputes arising out of construction agreements shall be governed by the laws of India. Any unresolved disputes shall be subject to arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with the venue in New Delhi, India.

ConstrixPrivacyPolicy1.title: Privacy Policy
ConstrixPrivacyPolicy1.intro: At Constrix, we respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding the personal information and property details you share with us. This policy outlines how we handle, store, and protect your data.

items.title: Information we collect
items.content: We collect information necessary to provide accurate construction estimates, architectural designs, and project management services. This includes your name, contact telephone number, email address, physical address, property survey documents, CAD drawings, site photographs, and transaction details provided during inquiries or contract execution.

items.title: How we use your information
items.content: Your information is used strictly to prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQ), communicate project milestones, manage on-site material deliveries, coordinate with statutory municipal authorities for plan approvals, issue warranty certifications, and respond to your service inquiries.

items.title: Information sharing and third parties
items.content: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal details to external marketing agencies. Project drawings and specifications may be shared only with certified subcontractors, structural testing laboratories (for NABL concrete and steel testing), and municipal bodies strictly on a need-to-know basis to fulfill construction deliverables.

items.title: Data protection and security
items.content: We implement industry-standard technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal and project records from unauthorized access, modification, or disclosure. All digital transmissions through our website are secured with SSL encryption.

items.title: Cookies and website analytics
items.content: Our website uses basic session and analytics cookies to ensure smooth navigation, load pages efficiently, and understand how visitors interact with our services. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time without restricting access to general website content.

items.title: Your rights and data control
items.content: You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you, request corrections to outdated contact details, or ask for the deletion of non-statutory records by writing to us at {email}.

items.title: Data retention
items.content: We retain client project records, engineering calculations, and warranty documents for the duration required to fulfill our 10-year structural warranty commitments and applicable statutory audit obligations. General inquiry details that do not result in a contract are removed after 24 months.

items.title: Contact and grievance redressal
items.content: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact our administrative desk at {email} or call {phone} during standard working hours.

ConstrixPrivacyPolicy1.metaDescription: Learn how Constrix collects, uses, and protects your personal and project information.

projectDetails.overview: The Modern Family Residence is a thoughtfully designed home that blends contemporary architecture with warm, functional interiors. The project focuses on creating open, airy spaces, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living while maintaining privacy and comfort for a modern family lifestyle.
projectDetails.approach: Our design approach centers on minimal aesthetics, natural materials and abundant natural light. Every element, from spatial planning to material selection, is carefully considered to ensure a cohesive, elegant and timeless design that enhances everyday living.
